name: Tianjin Tianyao Pharmaceuticals Co., Ltd.
summary: Tianjin Tianyao Pharmaceuticals Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sales of corticosteroids, amino acid active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), and preparations in China. The company's primary products comprising corticosteroid raw materials, such as dexamethasone, prednisone, methylprednisolone, betamethasone product series, and other hormone precursors. The company provides amino acid raw materials, as well as preparations, including injections, ointments, creams, hard capsules, pills, freeze-dried powder injections, inhalation preparations, and tablets. It also exports its products to the United States, Southeast Asia, Asia, Europe, South America, Africa,…
